# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering and platform compatibility**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.156 line improves rendering correctness and updates Apple and Uno platform requirements. Changes include display-paced Android rendering, Linux HarfBuzz coexistence fixes, corrected native callbacks, and fewer temporary allocations. Apple deployment minimums rise, while the Uno views move to Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple deployment targets** — Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15, superseding the earlier macOS 11/iOS 14 baseline. Raise application deployment targets accordingly and retain any higher framework requirement. Build settings support Xcode 27 while preserving .NET 9 targets and existing Xcode 26 CI. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Migrate Uno views to Uno Platform 7** — Non-Windows Uno views now require .NET 10 and Uno Platform 7; pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipelines are no longer supported. Migrate to Uno.Sdk's .NET SDK WebAssembly path. SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, uses a CPU raster fallback, returns a null GRContext, and drops RaiseOnUnsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering on Uno; the Windows facade remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Use rebuilt WebAssembly archives for WebGPU** — For consumers newer than .NET 8, WebGPU C++ support now comes from libSkiaSharp.a rather than application-side compilation. Custom native builds must supply rebuilt, Graphite-enabled archives containing that support; pre-change and GPU-disabled archives do not satisfy the link contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU link path is unchanged. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 correctness updates** — Rejects overflowing shader slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types, contains failed shader pipelines, and fixes conic-region storage sizing. Graphite retains hairline and subpixel stroke bounds and compares complete paint keys. Ganesh GL stops using a BGRA upload configuration invalid in GLES; readback is unchanged. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500), [#5517](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5517))

## Bug Fixes

- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of running as fast as buffer swaps allow. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests remain independent, and rendering resumes correctly after mode changes. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Native boolean callbacks match their ABI** — Corrects Skia callbacks to use one-byte native booleans and HarfBuzz callbacks to use four-byte hb_bool_t values, including false-return handling. This addresses Apple ARM64 interpreter callback behavior while keeping public managed bool signatures unchanged. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **HarfBuzzSharp can coexist with system HarfBuzz on Linux** — Binds internal bundled HarfBuzz function calls locally to prevent crashes caused by mixing private objects with another loaded HarfBuzz implementation, such as after GTK initialization. Exported entry points and managed signatures remain unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **StringUtilities validates encoded character width** — GetUnicodeCharacterCode accepts exactly one encoded unit: ASCII for UTF-8, BMP characters for UTF-16, and full Unicode code points for UTF-32. Invalid inputs report the character parameter correctly. GetString(byte[], ...) now throws ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException for null data. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **FromCString buffer over-read fixed** — Fixes a native buffer over-read in FromCString. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Fewer temporary allocations** — Managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation for valid buffers while preserving native validation for invalid inputs. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation without changing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered stream retention corrected** — Fixes retention behavior in front-buffered streams. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows integration dependencies** — Updates the WinUI ANGLE dependency to chromium/8118 and aligns Windows library dependencies with Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 for MAUI 9 and 10. Packaged ANGLE symbols use discoverable PDB names. The dependency refresh does not raise declared Windows runtime minimums. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
